items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex up 200 pts, Nifty tops 25,300; Cupid hits 52-wk high on Q2 profit growth
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Thursday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap rose 0.11 per cent and 0.72 per cent, respectively

items.title: Tata Power shares gain 2% after Q2 profit rises 33%; analysts upbeat
items.description: Tata Power reported 33 per cent y-o-y growth in PAT at ₹1,652 crore for Q2FY27 from ₹1,245 crore last year.

items.title: FIIs net buy ₹27,612 cr index futures in 7 days; long-short ratio nears 50%
items.description: Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) long-short ratio in index futures stands at 0.45, meaning 1 long bet for every 2 short positions. The ratio is at the highest point since July 2025.

items.title: Asian stocks fragile, Nvidia plummets as board to decide CEO's fate
items.description: Nvidia shares plunged in after-hours trading on news that its ​board may oust longtime CEO Jensen Huang
